analysis.title: Research Unplugged: 2027 Global Macro Outlook
key_insights: Podcast discussion of GS's 2027 Global Macro Outlook between Allison Nathan, Jan Hatzius (Chief Economist) and Dominic Wilson (Senior Markets Advisor), dated 13 November 2026. Topics named: global growth, inflation, central bank policy, and the path for equities and bonds in 2027.
The discussion also covers the potential impact of the Iran War, AI investment and fiscal deficits on the 2027 outlook.
The accompanying written outlook (Nov-12) is titled 'Macro Outlook 2027: Steady Baseline, Downside Risks', which indicates a steady base case with risks skewed to the downside.

The document text contains only the podcast summary, related-research list and disclosures. No forecasts, numbers, rates or asset-level calls appear in it, and the substantive views are in the audio and slides, which were not provided.
